records.text: Owens said footage around 1 p.m., a little over 30 minutes after Charlie Kirk went down, showed Terryl Farnsworth sitting in the back of what she believed was a Mercedes Sprinter and focused on footage; she said it looked as though the van belonged to the AV team.
